papers.title: Signal or Noise? Understanding Generative Models for Real-World Sensor Time Series
papers.what: SensorGen compares five generative-model families on sensor time series across 14 settings and finds flow-matching strongest, time-frequency conditioning best for high-frequency signals, and synthetic data useful for downstream tasks.
papers.builds_on: DDPM (Ho 2020); Diffusion Beats GANs (Dhariwal 2021); Foundation Models for Biosignals (Gu 2025)

papers.title: AREX: Towards a Recursively Self-Improving Agent for Deep Research
papers.what: A deep-research agent that pairs an inner evidence-gathering loop with an outer loop that audits its answer constraint-wise and re-researches unresolved parts, trained with long-horizon RL as 4B dense and 122B-A10B MoE models.

papers.title: Visual Contrastive Self-Distillation
papers.what: An on-policy self-distillation method for vision-language models that builds its teacher-student asymmetry from a contrast between the original image and a content-erased control, with no external teacher or extra inference cost.

papers.title: Predictive Divergence Masks for LLM RL
papers.what: Replaces the ratio-based direction test in PPO/DPPO trust-region masks with a closed-form prediction of the change in the trust-region divergence, plus top-K estimators, improving LLM RL across scales and precisions.
